chronicles.title: Chronicles
chronicles.locked: Finish the quests before it first
chronicles.turning: A machine near you turning at %s RPM
chronicles.quest.welcome.text: A world of gears and old magic. Claim a little help to start with.
chronicles.quest.first_alloy.text: Andesite or tuff with iron nuggets makes Ferrostone Alloy, what every machine is built from.
chronicles.quest.shafts_and_cogs.text: Shafts carry turning along a line; cogwheels pass it sideways, and reverse it.
chronicles.quest.hand_power.text: A hand crank turns what it sits on while you use it. Sneak to turn it the other way.
chronicles.quest.in_motion.text: Build a machine and set it turning: any part near you at 16 RPM or more will do.
chronicles.quest.millstone.text: A millstone grinds what is put in it while it turns; use it with an empty hand to take out what it ground. Grind wheat into flour, and bake the flour into bread. Mind the stress: a hand crank drives only two.
chronicles.quest.crushed_ore.text: A millstone grinds raw ore into crushed ore, and now and then gives one more. Smelted, each crushed ore gives an ingot.
chronicles.quest.pressing.text: A mechanical press turning over a depot presses what is put on the depot: ingots into sheets. A hopper beside the depot fills it, and one under it takes the sheets out.
chronicles.quest.goggles.text: Engineer's Goggles show how fast a part turns when you look at it.
chronicles.quest.water_power.text: A water wheel turns with the water flowing past it, faster with water on more sides.
chronicles.quest.wind_power.text: A windmill needs open sky above it, and turns faster the higher it stands.
chronicles.quest.control.text: A powered clutch parts a line; a powered gearshift turns it the other way.
chronicles.quest.full_speed.text: A large cogwheel driving a small one doubles the speed. Step a wheel's turning up to 128 RPM.
chronicles.quest.tin.text: Tin lies in the ground where copper does. Smelt the raw tin into ingots.
chronicles.quest.bronze.text: Three copper and one tin make four bronze.
chronicles.quest.lost_workshop.text: Tinkerers once worked in the forests and plains. Find one of their ruined workshops.
chronicles.quest.watchtower.text: The old realm watched its borders from stone towers. Climb into one of them.
